Hello Kavita,

We completely understand how concerning it is to see royalties on your dashboard for The Nagpur Notebooks yet nothing in your bank account, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention.

Looking at your account, you currently have 34 copies sold, generating a total royalty earned of Rs 850 with a pending royalty balance of Rs 850. As per our royalty policy, there is a minimum payout threshold of Rs 1,000. Because your current balance is below this threshold, your accumulated royalties of Rs 850 roll over to the next quarterly calculation and will be paid out once they reach Rs 1,000. 

You can view your detailed royalty breakdown and sales per platform directly in your author dashboard. 

Please check that your bank account details are correctly linked in your dashboard so that once your balance crosses the minimum threshold, your payout can be processed smoothly. 

Warm regards,
BookLeaf Support Team
